committee: * Presentation of Resolution No. 195-38- Senator Shelly V. Calvo-
title: The presentation of Resolution No. 195-38(COR) : Relative to recognizing the Filipino Ladies Association of Guam (FLAG) and the 2026 Sampaguita Coronation Ball in celebration of Filipino culture, leadership, and community service The presentation will take place on: Date: Sunday, June 21, 2026 Time: 6:00 PM Location: Crystal Ballroom, Lotte Hotel Guam Your presence is respectfully requested as we join in celebrating this meaningful occasion and recognizing the individuals and organizations whose dedication continues to strengthen our island community. 6.19.26 3:37pm (FN)
